question: Select the most appropriate answer to fill in blank 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **complicated**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Complicated: **involving a lot of different parts, in a way that is difficult to understand. (जटिल, पेचीदा, दुर्बोध)
 
• The sentence implies that Tattooing penmanship is difficult than sketching on paper.
 
• Thus, the most appropriate answer to fill in blank 5 is **option 3**. 

Correct Paragraph:__ *Tattooing is a talent that requires a lot of time and (1) __ability__. There are many various kinds and (2) __genres__ tattooing. Tattooing was and still is a means to communicate someone's thoughts or life by permanently (3) __embedding__* *a design of ink and colour into their flesh. The first step in tattooing is to develop an artistic (4) __attitude__* *and the skill to sketch and create your artwork. Tattooing penmanship is far more **(5)** __**complicated**__* *than sketching on paper.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Aggravated: **past participle of aggravate; to make something worse or more serious. ((स्थिति को) बिगाड़ देना)
 
• **Confiscated: **past participle of confiscate; to take something away from somebody as a punishment. (दंडस्‍वरूप कोई वस्‍तु ज़ब्‍त कर लेना)
 
• **Authenticated:** past participle of authenticate; to produce evidence to show that something is genuine, real or true. ((सच्‍चाई या असलियत को) प्रमाणित करना)
